issues.description: The Rideable.messageOnRide method has a parameter-list mismatch across artifacts. The problem statement UML and the template Main expect a no-argument method messageOnRide() returning String (UML: "messageOnRide():String" and template Main calls r.messageOnRide() with no arguments). The solution repository instead declares Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and the implementing classes Pig and Seal override that one-argument signature. This inconsistency will cause compilation errors for students who implement the interface as specified in the UML/template or who try to run the provided Main, and it is unclear which signature students should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the Rideable.messageOnRide signature across all artifacts. Recommended: change the solution to declare messageOnRide() with no parameters (String messageOnRide()), and update Pig and Seal to implement that no-arg method returning exactly "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]". Alternatively, if an equipment parameter is desired pedagogically, update the UML, problem text, and template Main to require messageOnRide(String equipment) and update example calls accordingly.
